The DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (owner) can grant the MINTER_ROLE to any address. As the attacker, we need to either: 1) Impersonate the owner to grant ourselves MINTER_ROLE, or 2) Directly call mint() if we already have MINTER_ROLE. Since we're testing on a forked network, we can use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner and grant ourselves the MINTER_ROLE, then call mint() to create tokens out of thin air.
